name: 88-aspect-ratio
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 14px; } p { margin: 0 0 8px; height: 20px; line-height: 20px; } img { display: block; margin: 0 0 16px 20px; border: 2px solid #345; box-sizing: content-box; object-fit: fill; } .by-width { width: 120px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 1; } .by-height { height: 40px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 1; } .square { width: 96px; aspect-ratio: 1; } .explicit { width: 96px; height: 48px; aspect-ratio: 5 / 1; }
html:
宽度 120px，比例 3:1，预期高 40px

高度 40px，比例 4:1，预期宽 160px

宽 96px，单值比例 1，预期 96×96

宽高均显式声明，aspect-ratio 不覆盖，预期 96×48
